title: Robinhood
desc: Robin's house was burned to ashes by the order of Alwyn, the Baron of Nottingham. Robin and his cousins Will, Winifred and Jenny flee into Sherwood Forest, hoping to escape persecution.

title: Guddu
desc: The sole objective of guddu's life is to spread joy & goodwill by entertaining the good people of falana nagar & dhimkana jungle.

title: Billa Jasoos
desc: A circus is arriving in a small town full of joy. A variety of cool performances brought a lot of joy into the town. The circus established a detective agency led by Detective Meow, which helps people solve various problems.

title: Bapu
desc: Treat your little ones at home to an entirely new channel to teach them the values and morals propagated by Mahatma Gandhi. Bapu, as the name of the show suggests, is an ideal way for your kids to learn the many teachings of Mahatma Gandhi.

title: Gattu
desc: Crystal City has an outright victory in the final battle against Twin City. But the G-Watch has exhausted much of its energy, which leads to the turbulence of its inner power.

title: Tutti Fruity
desc: Four friends who live in a city where food doesn't exist, and all citizens are forced to eat Genex-100, a high calorie compound available only via the Grand Corporation.

title: Invention Story
desc: Kit accidentally destroys Bod's new artwork given to him by the neighbouring village.

title: Gladiator
desc: A betrayed Roman general comes back as a gladiator to avenge the murder of his relatives.
